scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test:unit && bun run build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/api typecheck
scripts.build: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run --cwd apps/api build
scripts.test:unit: bun test apps/web/src apps/api/src/db apps/api/src/schemas apps/api/src/import/__tests__ apps/api/src/index.test.ts apps/api/src/static.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: bun run test:integration:up && bun run test:integration:run; CODE=$?; bun run test:integration:down; exit $CODE
